title: Pháp luật Hôn nhân và gia đình

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental principles of Vietnamese family law, including the legal framework, regulations, and legal relationships within families.
Analyze and evaluate legal issues related to marriage and family, distinguishing between different legal scenarios and their consequences.
Apply legal knowledge to resolve practical legal issues related to marriage and family, including advising clients on legal matters.
Conduct independent research and accumulate professional knowledge in the field of family law.
Develop the ability to critically assess and self-evaluate, form conclusions, and defend personal viewpoints.
Work effectively in groups and present findings in a professional manner.
Communicate effectively through presentations and discussions.
Solve legal problems related to marriage and family, including disputes over property, child custody, and alimony.
